description: The full Handy AI answer desk: the same question answered as a formatted news report in Markdown (bold lede, short sections, an image), followed by every Handy AI article and web page it read with images, the searches it ran, and a summary of its reasoning. structuredContent carries the same pieces as fields (answer_markdown, hero_image, sources, steps, thinking). Slower and longer than ask_handy_ai; use it when the answer will be shown to a person. Shares the 5-a-day allowance per connection with ask_handy_ai.

question.description: The question, in plain words. AI news, model releases, companies, research, or anything Handy AI has covered.
